appVersion.name: example-prebuilt
appVersion.configContent:
build:
    base: ubuntu@24.04
    deployFiles: ./
deploy:
    readinessCheck:
        exec:
            command: /var/www/sim check
        failureTimeout: 1m0s
        retryPeriod: 10s
    temporaryShutdown: true
run:
    prepareCommands:
        - sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq
        - echo revision1 | sudo tee /opt/example-prepare
    base: ubuntu@24.04
    start: ./sim
    volume:
        hostname: membervolume
        mountPath: /mnt/membervolume
        readOnly: false
    envVariables:
        EXAMPLE_CP: "no"
        EXAMPLE_OVERRIDE: yaml-wins
        EXAMPLE_VOLUME: /mnt/membervolume

prepareCustomRuntime.reason: No prepare runtime image cache available.
